title: MagicDNS name does not resolve (the one-letter-typo state)
titleZh: MagicDNS 名字解析不了(错一个字母的形态)
why: A misspelled tailnet name fails immediately with HostNotFound and looks nothing like a network problem. The measured lesson (baseline.md v1.2, C11) is that this must be a distinct blocked verdict keyed on the socket error code - which is why the collector walks the exception chain for SocketError instead of matching localized text.
inject: DNS probe for peer.example.test returns socketError=HostNotFound
